answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the cedar check immediately, the mirror audit keeps the resolved set and the relic replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 235 aliases therefore forfeits the reading cost 235 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
